typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		DEPOSIT_DATE as timestamp,
		SETTLEMENT_DATE as timestamp,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		MATURITY_DATE as timestamp,
		PRODUCT_ID as integer,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		VALUATION_DATE as timestamp,
		TRADE_COMMENT as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		EXPIRY_DATE as timestamp,
		DESCRIPTION as string,
		FINALMATDATE as string,
		BOOK_ID as integer,
		WITHD_DATE as timestamp,
		TRADE_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Deposti_Dte as string,
		SETTLEMENT_DATE as string,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		MATURITY_DATE as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as string,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		VALUATION_DATE as string,
		TRADE_COMMENT as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		EXPIRATION_DATE as string,
		DESCRIPTION as string,
		FINALMATDATE as string,
		BOOK_ID as string,
		Withdraw_Dte as string,
		TRADE_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Deposti_Dte = DEPOSIT_DATE,
		SETTLEMENT_DATE,
		BOOK_NAME,
		MATURITY_DATE,
		PRODUCT_ID,
		TRADE_STATUS,
		CURRENCY_CODE,
		VALUATION_DATE,
		TRADE_COMMENT,
		PRODUCT_TYPE,
		EXPIRATION_DATE = EXPIRY_DATE,
		DESCRIPTION,
		FINALMATDATE,
		BOOK_ID,
		Withdraw_Dte = WITHD_DATE,
		TRADE_ID),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
